line: Crowley's Queen of Cups: Hé of the Name (pdf p139); the watery part of Water and the span from Gemini to Cancer (pdf p151).

sections.title: The court and its element
sections.line: Crowley on the Queens (pdf p139) and on the Queen of Cups (pdf p151).

quotes.quote: The Queens represent the letter Hé of the Name.
The Queen of Cups represents the watery part of Water, its power of reception and reflection.

sections.title: Its span in the Zodiac
sections.line: Crowley on the span from the 21st degree of Gemini to the 20th degree of Cancer (pdf p151); on the decans and the elemental attribution (pdf p139).

quotes.quote: In the Zodiac it rules from the 21st degree of Gemini to the 20th degree of Cancer
instead of assigning the three decans of each sign to one card, the influence begins with the last decan of one Sign and continues to the second decan of the next.
It might well be expected that the elemental attribution would harmonize with the Zodiacal attribution; but it is not so.

sections.title: Character
sections.line: Crowley on the character of the Queen of Cups (pdf p151).

quotes.quote: She is the perfect agent and patient, able to receive and transmit everything without herself being affected thereby.
